prompt: Create a high-resolution studio portrait of a seated domestic short-haired cat on a clean seamless white background with a faint warm pink tint near the upper right. The cat is posed in three-quarter view facing left, sitting upright with slim elegant proportions, front paws together, tail curled along the floor in front, head turned toward the viewer, large upright ears, amber-gold eyes, a small orange-pink nose, and fine white whiskers. Render the fur as realistic and detailed but transformed by a vivid powder-pigment texture: mostly pale cream and white on the face and chest, bright orange and red speckled pigment concentrated across the forehead, ears, shoulder, back, and right flank, deep cobalt blue pigment covering the lower foreleg, belly, tail, and shadowed side, with a purple-magenta transition where red and blue overlap. The pigment should appear as thousands of tiny colored granules, splatters, and dust particles sitting on and blending into the fur, with denser color on the body and tail and lighter freckles on the face and neck. Use soft diffused studio lighting, subtle floor contact shadow, crisp focus on the eyes and fur texture, shallow natural depth, vibrant saturated colors, photorealistic yet slightly surreal fine-art animal photography. No collar, no props, no text, no watermark, no extra animals.

promptZh: 创作一张高分辨率的摄影棚肖像，主体为一只坐姿的 家养短毛猫，背景为干净无缝的白色，右上角带有淡淡的暖粉色调。猫咪呈四分之三侧面朝左，坐姿端正，体态纤细优雅，前爪并拢，尾巴在身前沿地面卷曲，头部转向观众，大耳朵竖立，琥珀金色的眼睛，小巧的橙粉色鼻子，以及细长的白色胡须。将毛发渲染得逼真且细腻，并呈现出鲜艳的粉末颜料纹理：面部和胸部主要为奶油色和白色，明亮的橙色和红色斑点颜料集中在额头、耳朵、肩膀、背部和右侧侧腹，深钴蓝色颜料覆盖前腿下部、腹部、尾巴和阴影侧，红色与蓝色交汇处呈现紫红色的过渡。颜料应表现为成千上万细小的彩色颗粒、飞溅点和粉尘，附着并融合在毛发中，身体和尾巴上的颜色较浓密，面部和颈部则有较浅的斑点。使用柔和的漫射摄影棚灯光，带有微妙的地面接触阴影，眼睛和毛发纹理对焦清晰，浅景深，色彩鲜艳饱和，呈现出既写实又略带超现实感的艺术动物摄影效果。无项圈，无道具，无文字，无水印，无其他动物。
